mintAuthority.summary: sUSDe is Ethena's savings wrapper over USDe. Ethereum wrapper shares are minted against deposited USDe and the many bridged/wrapped deployments inherit base USDe's signed-order issuer mint path.

controls.label: Ethereum sUSDe staking wrapper
controls.capDescription: Wrapper/share accounting over deposited USDe; does not mint base USDe.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25711751, asset() returned USDe 0x4c9edd5852cd905f086c759e8383e09bff1e68b3 and both EIP-1967 implementation and admin slots were zero, confirming a direct non-proxy deployment. owner() returned Ethena's 86,400-second timelock 0xe8dc0fab349ea169283c48ccfd09d797e6db7c94. Wrapper shares mint only against deposited USDe; no privileged path can create unbacked wrapper shares.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25711751, the sUSDe contract's asset() was USDe, both EIP-1967 implementation and admin slots were zero, and owner() returned Ethena's 86,400-second timelock. The direct non-proxy wrapper has no privileged unbacked-share mint: local shares are created only against deposited USDe, so local issuance is bounded while durable USDe authority remains inherited from usde-ethena. No local reserve reconciliation or named prudential supervisor applies to the wrapper.
